# altdoc

> Package Documentation Websites with 'Quarto', 'Docsify', 'Docute', or 'MkDocs'

## Reference

- [preview_docs()](https://altdoc.etiennebacher.com/man/preview_docs.md): Preview the documentation in a webpage or in viewer
- [render_docs()](https://altdoc.etiennebacher.com/man/render_docs.md): Update documentation
- [setup_docs()](https://altdoc.etiennebacher.com/man/setup_docs.md): Initialize documentation website settings
- [setup_github_actions()](https://altdoc.etiennebacher.com/man/setup_github_actions.md): Create a Github Actions workflow

- [Customize](https://altdoc.etiennebacher.com/vignettes/customize.md)
- [Deploy](https://altdoc.etiennebacher.com/vignettes/deploy.md)
- [Get started](https://altdoc.etiennebacher.com/vignettes/get-started.md)
